verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is an in-person payments and POS product with a developer extension platform, so testing integrations against a simulated reader or test card environment is a fair question. The evidence covers UI extensions, Shopify CLI scaffolding and Tap to Pay, but nothing about a simulated card reader, test card mode or an end-to-end sandbox for in-person payments. CLI scaffolding is a developer building block, not a test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live
